question: Which ideas from the supplied conversation corpus should be reused as input for the semantic organization / context-bubble direction in this repo, and how should they be organized for integration?

canonical_duplicates.reason: Body content is functionally identical; frontmatter differs.

integration_surfaces.label: Fragment-First Capture
integration_surfaces.description: Keep fragments as canonical intake objects with semantic anchors and generate depth later.

integration_surfaces.label: Context Bubble Layer
integration_surfaces.description: Introduce an intermediate semantic organization layer that groups fragments and meta records into evolving wholes around a pressure point.

integration_surfaces.label: Multi-Domain Routing
integration_surfaces.description: Allow one fragment or bubble to route into multiple reasoning lenses instead of forcing a single interpretation.

integration_surfaces.label: Reasoning Profile Layer
integration_surfaces.description: Track stable patterns in how the user reasons without collapsing them into source truth.

integration_surfaces.label: Pointer-Style Retrieval
integration_surfaces.description: Use compressed, relevance-weighted retrieval behavior as a design direction for later retrieval and context-pack building.

integration_surfaces.label: Swarm-Supervised Execution
integration_surfaces.description: Use specialized workers, shared state, supervisors, and guards when operating on bubbles or producing outputs from them.

context_bubbles.label: Fragment-First Substrate
context_bubbles.thesis: The smallest durable unit should be a fragment with semantic anchors; deeper forms should be generated or assembled on demand.
gaps: current chunks are still mostly textual slices
semantic anchors are not explicit first-class fields

context_bubbles.label: Context Bubble Layer
context_bubbles.thesis: Fragments and meta records should be grouped into provisional coherence fields that hold a larger unresolved whole.
gaps: themes exist but evolving wholes do not
there is no bubble-aware surfacing stage

context_bubbles.label: Multi-Domain Routing
context_bubbles.thesis: A single fragment or bubble can legitimately belong to several lenses at once, and those lenses should be allowed to react to one another.
gaps: current system has primitives but not explicit lens competition

context_bubbles.label: Reasoning Profile Layer
context_bubbles.thesis: The system should store abstractions about how the user reasons without confusing them with raw source material.
gaps: feedback is not yet shaping stable cognitive abstractions

context_bubbles.label: Weighted Reasoning Routing
context_bubbles.thesis: Reasoning quality depends on selecting and constraining the computational path, not only on the base model.
gaps: no routing weights on current primitives
candidate evaluation is not yet path-aware

context_bubbles.label: Pointer Memory Router
context_bubbles.thesis: Retrieval should increasingly resolve pointers into compressed context rather than replaying large raw windows.
gaps: no explicit pointer cache or relevance-weighted echo behavior

context_bubbles.label: Swarm Supervision
context_bubbles.thesis: Specialized workers with shared state and supervisor logic can raise reliability when operating on bubbles or producing derived outputs.
gaps: pipelines exist but agent roles are implicit
quality control is not modeled as specialized workers

context_bubbles.label: Decision Point Metaphor
context_bubbles.thesis: Triggered activation and decisive state change are useful patterns, but the religious framing should remain outside core system ontology.
gaps: high risk of mixing metaphor with implementation truth

recommended_next_steps: Create a first-class context bubble layer between meta extraction and thought surfacing.
Seed the first bubble set manually from tier_a sources instead of relying on unsupervised clustering.
Extend relation records so they carry typed roles, evidence strength, and bubble membership.
Keep source substrate, semantic objects, and reasoning profile as separate memory surfaces.
Translate swarm and weighted-reasoning concepts into execution workflows rather than core ontology.
Use adaptive-layer and cryptographic-router material only as later retrieval design pressure.
